concepts.description: A modular unit representing the AUV system architecture.
A platform representing the physical robotic system of the AUV.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate.
A control component within the AUV module responsible for managing specific operations.
A basic data type defined within the AUV module to represent simple values.
A structured data type defined within the AUV module to group multiple related values.
A data field defined within a Composite Type to hold a specific named value.
An event defined within an Interface that can be triggered to perform specific actions or return values.
A callable operation defined within the AUV module that takes inputs and returns a result.

instances.description: The module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV system, using Sensors and Actuators interfaces.
An interface used by AUV_Platform to receive sensor data.
An interface used by AUV_Platform to send commands to actuators.
The controller responsible for operator-level control of the AUV, using the Inputs interface.
An interface used by AUV_Operator to receive input commands.
The Last Response Engine controller, using both Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot to send output commands.
The autopilot controller of the AUV, using the Outputs interface.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values.
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector with radial, polar, and azimuth fields of type real.
A field of type real representing the radial component of SVec.
A field of type real representing the polar component of SVec.
A field of type real representing the azimuth component of SVec.
A composite type representing an obstacle with fields ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id (all of type real), and obs_hdng of type SVec.
A field of type real representing the north-south relative distance in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type real representing the east-west relative distance in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type real representing the depth in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type real representing the identifier in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type SVec representing the obstacle heading in the Obstacle composite type.
A value of type SVec representing heading, defined in the Sensors interface.
A value of type Obstacle representing observed obstacle data, defined in the Sensors interface.
An interface (intended as Inputs) defined in AUV_Module containing events endTask, reqOCM, reqMOM, reqHCM, reqVel, and reqHdng.
An event with no parameters and no return value, defined in the Inputs interface.
An event with no parameters and no return value, defined in the Inputs interface.
An event with no parameters and no return value, defined in the Inputs interface.
An event with no parameters and no return value, defined in the Inputs interface.
An event with no parameters but with a return value of type real, defined in the Inputs interface.
An event with no parameters but with a return value of type real, defined in the Inputs interface.
An event that takes one parameter of type real and no return value, defined in the Outputs interface.
An event that takes one parameter of type real and no return value, defined in the Outputs interface.
A composite type recording horiz_cda and vert_cda (of type real) and id (of type nat).
A field of type real representing the horizontal closest distance of approach in the Close composite type.
A field of type real representing the vertical closest distance of approach in the Close composite type.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the obstacle as real.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the obstacle as real.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the obstacle as real.
